From Academy Award® nominee Taylor Sheridan, comes The Madison, starring Michelle Pfeiffer and Kurt Russell.

The new Paramount+ Original follows the Clyburns as they uproot their comfortable New York City lives for the wild, untamed beauty of Montana’s Madison River Valley. Stream The Madison March 14 only on Paramount+.
